research.spy_sma10_20261023.state@1.0.0.scope: SPY USD adjusted-price historical sequential scenario, 1994-01 to 2026-08

research.spy_sma10_20261023.hold@1.0.0.name: SPY固定月度研究 hold

definition.formula: initial affordable purchase then unchanged adjusted units
definition.direction: separate return/risk evaluation; not predictive certainty
definition.transforms: only declared monthly mean and account policy

policy.weights: initial affordable purchase then unchanged adjusted units
policy.cash: USD100000, zero interest/no flows/borrowing; fractional adjusted units
policy.fees: each buy/sell notional times 0/0.001/0.0025 hypothetical friction; no minimum/tax/FX; not personal fee schedule
policy.rebalance: first observed monthly open when applicable
policy.execution: mark old units at open then solve post-fee target, close valuation
policy.exit: target change only, no terminal sale
policy.investability: adjusted quote proxy; no actual dividend cash, broker or capacity verification
